verdict.rationale: Formant is a robot fleet-management SaaS platform, not an AI agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence covers SDKs, APIs, webhooks, an llms.txt file and an in-product AI assistant, but nothing documents an official MCP server or endpoint. The 'Formant agent' is an on-device telemetry daemon and does not count as one.
